description: NaLiLa₂Ti₄O₁₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with eight equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.67 Å) and eight longer (2.87 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Li is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Li-O bond lengths are 2.00 Å. La is bonded to twelve O atoms to form LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with four equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.67-2.77 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-9°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-1.97 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent La, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Li, two equivalent La, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent La, and two equivalent Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaLa₂Ti₂ square pyramids.
